articles.title: Hitzewelle in Frankreich: Und jetzt auch noch eine Quallenplage
articles.teaser: Extreme Hitze, Dürre, mit Quallen verstopfte Filter: Frankreich muss mehrere Atomkraftwerke drosseln oder gar komplett abschalten. Das führt auch zu steigenden Preisen.
articles.image_title: Hitzewelle in Frankreich: A jellyfish lies on the shore near the Gravelines nuclear power plant in Gravelines, northern France on August 11, 2026. A nuclear plant in northern France shut down three reactors after a swarm of jellyfish clogged pumps used to cool the units, energy group EDF said on August 11, 2026. Three reactors were taken offline on August 10, 2026 and output at a fourth was cut by half, EDF said in a statement, leaving just one operating at full capacity.
